title: Genetics of psychic ability - A pilot case-control exome sequencing study
citation: Wahbeh H, Radin D, Yount G, Woodley of Menie MA, Sarraf MA, Karpuj MV. EXPLORE 2021; 18(3):264-271 (2022).
design: Whole-exome sequencing, 13 self-described psychic cases vs 10 matched controls (9 analysed after QC).

target.hgvs_transcript: NM_001080495.3:c.4533-59C>T (gene is on the minus strand; plus-strand change is G>A)

cases.note: All cases carried the reference (wild-type) sequence; GG is implied, not tabulated.

controls.note: The remaining 2 controls are not explicitly genotyped; AA is not mentioned.

population_af_alt_A.note: Values from the research report (Ensembl / MyVariant / dbSNP). gnomAD version labels were not verified.

method_notes: Original calls: hg19, STAR 2.5.2b alignment, SAMtools calling, variant quality >= 30.
The site is 59 bp into an intron at the edge of exome capture; original calls may rest on thin coverage.
No raw data or per-sample genotypes were published.
